title: Learnable Low-Rank Polynomial Sketch for Effective Linear Attention
abstract: arXiv:2610.14219v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Softmax attention in Transformers suffers from quadratic complexity in sequence length, making it impractical for long-context applications. Linear attention alleviates this issue by replacing the exponential kernel with alternative functions that enable linear-time computation. Among existing linear attention approaches, recent studies have shown that polynomial kernels are particularly effective, as they exhibit sparse and spiky behavior similar to softmax attention, which emphasizes large dot products while suppressing irrelevant interactions. However, the exact computation of high-degree polynomial kernels is infeasible for high-dimensional representations. As a result, prior work relies on approximate polynomial kernels. This introduces a non-negligible approximation error. In this paper, we show that, from the perspective of polynomial kernel approximation, existing linear attention methods are still suboptimal. translated_title: 面向高效线性注意力的可学习低秩多项式草图
translated_abstract: Transformer中的Softmax注意力机制在序列长度上具有二次方复杂度，使其难以应用于长上下文场景。线性注意力通过用替代函数替换指数核来缓解这一问题，从而实现线性时间的计算。在现有线性注意力方法中，近期研究表明多项式核尤为有效，因为它们表现出与softmax注意力相似的稀疏和尖锐（spiky）特性，即强调较大的点积同时抑制无关交互。然而，对于高维表示，高阶多项式核的精确计算是不可行的。因此，先前的工作依赖于近似多项式核，这引入了不可忽略的近似误差。在本文中，我们从多项式核逼近的角度证明，现有的线性注意力方法仍然是次优的。我们提出了一种可学习的低秩多项式草图方法……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文从多项式核逼近的角度揭示了现有线性注意力方法的次优性，并提出一种可学习的低秩多项式草图，以更小的近似误差实现高效的线性时间注意力计算。
